name: Nikola Petrović
bio:
Nikola Petrović's journey in motorsport began in the dusty workshops of Belgrade, tinkering with Lada engines as a teenager. His practical skills quickly shone, leading him to work as a mechanic for various rally teams across the Balkans. Recognizing his aptitude for organization and logistics, he transitioned into operational roles, eventually landing a position as the head of operations for a smaller racing outfit before joining Hot Racing Team.

Nikola's approach is rooted in meticulous planning and efficient execution. He believes in empowering his team, fostering a culture of accountability and clear communication. His pragmatic nature allows him to make tough decisions under pressure, always prioritizing the team's overall goals. What sets Nikola apart is his unflappable demeanor and his ability to find practical solutions to even the most complex challenges, earning him the respect of his colleagues and competitors alike. He's known for his calm head in the pits and his ability to pull the team through any situation.

physical.description: Nikola is a man of medium build with a weathered face that reflects years spent trackside.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with detailed notes and diagrams.
Has a peculiar habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on starting every day with a strong cup of Serbian coffee.
